ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:2.5 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary irregular high-contrast white patches are situated on the distal regions of both lobes. The left lobe patch is more contiguous with jagged interior boundaries; the right lobe patch is more fragmented with a higher density of black pixel intrusions (mottling).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 52 degrees; the vertex of the notch is occluded by splashing water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel variation) along the entire trailing boundary; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits three distinct macro-depressions (notches) between the center and tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the distal leading edges transitioning to a concave sweep at the medial trailing edges near the notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured yellowish-white pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both lateral fluke tips; small isolated circular white mark (approx. 4px diameter) on the left medial lobe surface.
